description: A PHP class defining an extension report controller for customer reward points in OpenCart, including methods for displaying, saving settings, and generating reports.

classes.name: CustomerReward
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer reward points reporting, including display, save, and data processing functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main customer reward report form page with initialized data and UI components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration settings for the customer reward report if user has permission.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares data and renders the customer reward report page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches and displays a list of customer reward point data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Gathers and returns a string containing the customer reward report data based on filter parameters.
